status: Definition only; no new benchmark executed
main_objective: Final-answer correctness on each independent dataset under declared comparable resources

primary_metrics.deterministic: accuracy = correct/N for fixed greedy/sampling protocol
primary_metrics.stochastic: pass@1 = average per-question sample success fraction, all samples included
primary_metrics.pass_at_k: at least one success among k attempts; separate budget and not relabeled pass@1
primary_metrics.macro_average: optional, weights fixed before test, cannot replace per-dataset rows

comparison_controls: same total token/model-call/tool-call or declared GPU budget

grading.unparseable_timeout_OOM: prespecified treatment with full denominator and failure row, never silently dropped

data_separation.final_test: problem identities not used to construct q, labels, thresholds or choose method

uncertainty: paired per-question changes and question-cluster uncertainty across repeated samples; small datasets reported with sample size
formal_execution: Complete declared benchmark scope required for a performance claim; partial pilot remains diagnostic
novelty: Cite borrowed modules; establish new operation/objective and incremental benefit with same-data/tool/compute baselines; no acceptance guarantee
